New message in #sales:

mike: does anyone know the current MRR for Acme Corp?

input.text: Hey @mike — I don't have access to our CRM or billing data from here, so I can't pull Acme Corp's current MRR. Best bet would be to check in [your billing/CRM system] directly, or @-mention someone on the finance/revenue team who can look it up. If you can point me to where that data lives, I can try to help dig in.
